# Getting help

- **Using or hosting ManaWG:** ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Abuarchiv/manawg/discussions).
  Search there first; your question may already be answered.
- **Self-hosting:** the [self-hosting guide](../docs/self-hosting.md) covers setup, configuration,
  updates and backups. If it does not solve your problem, open a
  [self-hosting issue](https://github.com/Abuarchiv/manawg/issues/new/choose).
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/Abuarchiv/manawg/issues/new/choose).
- **Security problems:** report them privately, see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

ManaWG is maintained by one person in their free time, so answers can take a few days.
